status: Frozen before any ranking-loss training/scoring and before any test gold release
hypothesis: Language-wise ranking derived directly from human training ratings improves the deployed equal-seed ensemble rank correlation beyond weighted-MSE-only control. No generated text or pseudo-label dataset is introduced.
one_change: Add pairwise logistic ranking loss to the original language-balanced weighted MSE objective; retain architecture, optimizer, features, source split and checkpoint rules.
pairs: Within each training minibatch/language only, unordered pairs with absolute human target gap >=0.1. Equal mean over eligible languages. Logistic loss on pre-sigmoid logit differences; signs from existing human scores. No validation/test-derived pairs.
training: Same batch 64, maximum 50 epochs, minimum 3 epochs, patience 6, gradient clip 1; each seed best validation macro Spearman, earliest tie. No warm starts.
selection: Equal-three-seed deployed probability ensemble per ranking weight. Promote only +0.005 macro Spearman above prior and no per-language Spearman drop >0.02 from prior; retain prior otherwise. Compare all fixed weights, strict greater objective, earliest tie.
compute: Actual small cached-head training on local CPU, two Torch threads, one head at a time; no encoder allocated. Full encoder pretraining/fine-tuning is not claimed. Original GPU quota remains exhausted; no paid compute.
test: Keep gold sealed until ranking study completes and global serialized policy is locked. Final test one release via atomic marker, no test-guided changes.
confounders: Repeated validation selection on 386 rows creates optimism.
Ranking pairs reuse existing examples and are not independent extra supervision.
Source sentence reuse and unknown encoder pretraining exposure remain.
Local head runtime Python3.14/Torch2.14 differs from cloud encoder Python3.13/Torch2.11; no hardware-independent bitwise claim.
Ridge BLAS thread count was not instrumented in original live process; Torch heads explicitly use2threads.
stop: Stop each fit on original validation plateau; after fixed ranking weights, assess recorded validation evidence rather than add arbitrary grids. Any encoder training requires a new protocol and measured CPU feasibility.
